paragraphs: Rabbah bar Rav Nahman bar Yaakov. Because he had Rabbah bar Rav Huna’s trees cut down, the latter cursed him, and his offspring did not endure (Bava Metzia 108a adds that this lasted during Rabbah bar Rav Huna’s lifetime). Rabbah bar Rav Huna visited Rava bar Rav Nahman's house: Menahot 41a; Shabbat 119a. Rabbah bar Rav Huna sent to Rabbah bar Rav Nahman, ‘Let our teacher instruct us’: Yevamot 25a.
